CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTSECURITIESPORTFOLIO_SEC
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio AS (
	SELECT 
		BSP.ID AS CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
		,BSP.REFDATE AS Datestamp
		,BSP.SECURITY AS Security
		,BSP.ENDSHARES AS EndShares
		,BSP.ENDVALUE AS EndValue
		,BSP.CUSTCODE AS CustomerAccountId
		,BSP.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BSP.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		,BSPD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.SEC_PORTFOLIO_DELTA BSPD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_PORTFOLIO BSP ON BSPD.ID = BSP.ID AND BSP.isLatest = '1'
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio;


WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
			,Datestamp
			,Security
			,EndShares
			,EndValue
			,CustomerAccountId)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
		,RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
			,Datestamp
			,Security
			,EndShares
			,EndValue
			,CustomerAccountId)) AS HASHROW        
			,CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio
	-- WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'SEC'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId,TGT.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId) AS CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId = TGT.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET
[CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId] = SRC.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
,[Datestamp] = SRC.Datestamp
,[Security] = SRC.Security
,[EndShares] = SRC.EndShares
,[EndValue] = SRC.EndValue
,[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'SEC'
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = getDate()
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId = TGT.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId = TGT.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId ;


INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio (
	[CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId]
	,[Datestamp]
	,[Security]
	,[EndShares]
	,[EndValue]
	,[CustomerAccountId]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId]
	,[Datestamp]
	,[Security]
	,[EndShares]
	,[EndValue]
	,[CustomerAccountId]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA;

END
